mentions.name: Quote Machine
mentions.description: A free quote generation service that runs entirely in the browser with no sign-up and produces live PDFs. It is built as a React app with no backend, hosted on GCP at almost no cost, and the author plans to open-source it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Ha! I built a similar service for quote generation a couple of month ago: https://quotemachine.cc

No signups, free for all, browser-only, live pdfs, etc

Built it for a friend and decided to share with all, it's just a react app (no backend) running on GCP and costs almost nothing to run.
